"import cadquery as cq

# Establish the XZ workplane. Local (u, v) maps to global (u, 0, v).
P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")

def W(u, v):
    """Map local sketch coordinates (u, v) to world coordinates on the XZ plane."""
    return P.toWorldCoords((u, v))

# --- Fit points for the smooth spline (local coords) ---
spline_fit_local = [(-28, 0), (-14, 21), (0, 26), (14, 21), (28, 0)]
spline_fit_world = [W(u, v) for (u, v) in spline_fit_local]

# --- Three curve entities forming exactly one closed profile ---

# (1) Line from (28, 0) to (0, -18)
line1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(W(28, 0), W(0, -18))

# (2) Line from (0, -18) to (-28, 0)
line2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(W(0, -18), W(-28, 0))

# (3) Fitted spline through (-28,0) -> (-14,21) -> (0,26) -> (14,21) -> (28,0)
spline = cq.Edge.makeSpline(spline_fit_world)

# Collect exactly the three required curves
edges = [line1, line2, spline]

# Export the sketch as a compound of edges to sketch.step
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
